newsitem.title: FRANCE: Beatle daughter McCartney named designer at Chloe.
newsitem.headline: Beatle daughter McCartney named designer at Chloe.

text.p: Stella McCartney, the designer daughter of former Beatle Paul McCartney, is taking over from Karl Lagerfeld at French fashion house Chloe, house executives said on Tuesday.

McCartney, 25, a graduate of London's celebrated Saint Martin's School which also spawned British fashion talents John Galliano and Alexander McQueen, will present her first show for Chloe next October during the 1998 Spring Summer collections.
"She will bring a freshness and sexiness to Chloe and will revive an interest in Chloe's early reputation," McCartney's spokeswoman Paris Morgan told Reuters.
"She is very interested in vintage and antique clothing and the quality and design sensitivity that one rarely sees now," she added.

As a teenager McCartney apprenticed with Christian Lacroix and later in men's tailoring on London's Savile Row before launching her signature line Stella McCartney Ltd in 1995 near Portobello market in London.

Morgan said the line "will cease to exist for now" because Stella will become Chloe". She said McCartney has enrolled in a French class and would probably fly back and forth between her London home and her work in Paris.
Lagerfeld announced in March he was leaving Chloe to devote more time to his KL signature collection and Chanel.
